notes: Release date 2026-07-06 printed on the official blog page (JS-rendered SPA; rendered via headless browser; OpenRouter tencent/hy3 created 2026-07-06 matches). Open-sourced under Apache 2.0 on GitHub/HuggingFace/ModelScope/AtomGit. Page prose gives MRCR 75.1% (from 42.9% on Hy3 preview) as DOM text — verified; the appendix 模型得分 table renders as one image; its 40 rows were transcribed and then confirmed by re-reading the archived image (data/model-releases/official/_archive/tencent/hy3/images/, Read tool, 2026-09-01) — all 40 upgraded to verified with locator.figure pointing at the archived band. Appendix note verbatim (translated): reasoning effort highest tier for all models; results with * are from our own testing (competitor columns not transcribed as rows). Internal in-house benchmarks (Hy-Backend 2.0, Hy-SWE Max, Hy-CompanyBench, e-bench, Hy-FinModelBench, ProdBench, Hy-SkillsWorld, Hy-Euler pro, Hy-Math) are vendor-owned. Also disclosed in prose: cross-scaffold SWE Bench Verified std within 4pp across Codebuddy/Cline/KiloCode; internal 270-expert blind test Hy3 2.67/4 vs GLM5.1 2.51/4; hallucination rate 12.5%→5.4% and common-sense error rate 25.4%→12.7% vs preview (internal product evals, notes only). API price 1/4/0.25 CNY per M tokens.  2026-09-01 audit: all 5 appendix split panels (images/split/01-05.png) re-read in full - 41 numeric table cells match the 41 value-bearing entries exactly (Agentic Coding 9 / Agentic Search 3 / Working Agent 12 / STEM Agent 2 / Reasoning 13 / Context Learning 3 incl. AA-LCR 73.4); the one null row (swebench-verified-mention) is a prose robustness claim (std < 4pp across Codebuddy/Cline/KiloCode scaffolds) with no printed score, correctly not_reported. No missing benchmark item. Panel Notes column confirms: reasoning effort highest tier; * = vendor own testing; SWE-agent / Claude Code / Terminus-2 / mini-swe-agent scaffolds; MCP-Atlas = Scale April-2026 methodology, 500-task public set, Gemini 2.5 Pro judge; ClawEval = 20260325 version, 105 queries, Gemini-3.5-flash judge; FrontierScience-Olympiad self-evaluated with OpenAI paper judge prompts (gpt-oss-120b high).
